ux_observations.observation: Job terminated with 'timeout' status and no video output was produced. The pipeline failed to complete execution entirely, resulting in zero deliverable for the customer.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Investigate timeout root cause—check if the 6 active add-ons exceeded processing time limits. Implement chunked processing or increase timeout thresholds for jobs with 4+ add-ons. Add automatic retry with reduced add-on complexity as fallback.

ux_observations.observation: Output URL is NONE, meaning the customer received nothing despite initiating a paid OPERATE tier job. This is a complete service failure.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Implement partial output recovery—if timeout occurs mid-render, save and deliver whatever frames/segments completed. Trigger immediate customer notification with ETA for resolution or automatic refund/credit.

ux_observations.observation: Twelve Labs QA returned 'no result' which means content quality validation never ran. Without QA verification, even if output had been produced, quality standards would be unverified.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Ensure QA hooks are triggered earlier in pipeline (not just post-render). Add health check to confirm Twelve Labs API connectivity before job starts. Log why QA was skipped—timeout before QA stage vs. QA service unavailable.

ux_observations.observation: Six add-ons activated simultaneously (captions, audio, branding, colorGrade, effects, layout) for 'Post Everywhere' template. This is a heavy combination that may have contributed to the timeout.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Profile processing time per add-on combination. For 'post_everywhere' jobs, consider parallelizing independent add-ons (e.g., captions + colorGrade can run concurrently). Set realistic SLAs based on add-on count.

ux_observations.observation: No intermediate status or progress indicators captured between job start and timeout. Customer likely had no visibility into why their job was taking long or failing.
ux_observations.suggested_change: Implement progress checkpoints (e.g., 'captions complete', 'color grading at 50%') and expose via customer dashboard. Add proactive timeout warning at 80% of limit with option to extend or simplify.
